question: Can the exact P4BK Table 1 coefficients be compiled into immutable typed historical B&W one-dimensional, aperture-convolved two-dimensional and aperture-corrected intrinsic Wiener spectra that numerically reproduce the published projection identity over a bounded zero-free frequency interval?

branch_rule.pass: Retain the five exact historical Fuji B&W spectra as an offline measured-NPS reference and open a separately frozen spatial-field synthesis/parity leaf that must preserve these spectra and physical scale.
branch_rule.fail: Close the compiled NPS route without changing equations, coefficients, aperture, frequency interval or numerical gates; retain the P4BK source only.

forbidden: fit or tune coefficients after compilation
interpolate or extrapolate between measured densities
transfer profiles to Kodak 250D, colour dye-cloud layers or arbitrary film
compose with P4BJ amplitudes as though independently calibrated quantities were jointly identified
render photographs or alter product defaults
claim_ceiling: Typed exact compiler for five historical Fuji black-and-white measured spectra on 0-500 lines/mm, reproducing the source projection and aperture correction; not colour-film structure, modern-stock calibration, scanner response, photographic quality or product evidence.
